name: Masked Charlatan
description:
You are able to wear Mesmer’s masks, a special equipment type. While worn, a mask magically adheres to your face and cannot be removed except by you. Putting on or removing a mask costs a half action.

When you put on a mask for the first time, roll the mask’s Discovery Skill to set its Discovery Number. Once per day per mask, you may re-roll its Discovery Skill to set a new Discovery Number.

You may attempt to discover a mask’s abilities using Mesmerize. Once gained, Mesmer abilities may be used while wearing any Mesmer’s mask.

Describe how you wear your mask.
